metadata.purpose: Identification and reference facts, not safe overclock presets or mining compatibility guarantees
metadata.unknown_values: null means not established for the exact identity; never fill by interpolation
metadata.matching_policy: Prefer PCI device/subsystem plus actual model and form factor; name-only matches can be ambiguous
metadata.tuning_policy: Read supported capabilities and limits from the actual GPU/driver; never use published reference power as a control limit
metadata.legacy_policy: Presence in this catalogue does not imply support in a current driver, CUDA version, miner, or Pearl algorithm

sources.evidence_scope: Official product names, PCI and subsystem identifiers; includes legacy appendix
Modern architecture by family and curated desktop reference memory/power variants
Modern architecture by family and RTX50 laptop memory/subsystem power ranges
Legacy product compute capability where exact names match
